verdict.rationale: Elicit's own docs describe deleting papers from the Library with a defined 30-day recoverable window before permanent deletion. That is a real first-party deletion and retention behavior, but it only covers Library papers. Export features concern portability, not retention control, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, deletion of sessions/chats/account data, policy on retaining uploaded content or using it for model training, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: They will stay there for 30 days before being permanently deleted, and are recoverable at any point in that window.
